authority_support_rows.assumptions: Domain three, binary scopes, stable version token, existential feedback.
authority_support_rows.counterexample_boundary: A ternary rule or relation outside the seven tables is unsupported.

authority_support_rows.assumptions: Pairwise separation belongs to the declared CCA schedule language.
authority_support_rows.counterexample_boundary: No arbitrary compound or hidden drift claim follows.

authority_support_rows.assumptions: CCA permits a named global capacity family under exact feedback.
authority_support_rows.counterexample_boundary: Exp7351 contains no global-capacity atom or measurement.

authority_support_rows.assumptions: Ternary challenge answers test abstention, not binary-rule authority.
authority_support_rows.counterexample_boundary: A ternary not-all-equal rule cannot justify pairwise atoms.

authority_support_rows.assumptions: The target must belong to the finite bias; query count and time stay separate.
authority_support_rows.counterexample_boundary: Support ends when the target is outside these seven tables.

authority_support_rows.assumptions: Learned labels can be wrong and are not exact executor authority.
authority_support_rows.counterexample_boundary: No neural-oracle accuracy or authority was measured.

field_principles.run_date: Use 20260917 and retain real UTC boundaries.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Preserve planned, attempted, completed, censored, and stopping values.
field_principles.schema: Version this record and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Retain exact producer and input byte hashes.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after actual work and affected validation.
field_principles.unchanged_method_disposition: Retire an unchanged benchmark until a named mechanism changes.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain current command, scope, exit, elapsed time, and log hash.
